topic: Divergence and Curl: Visualizing Vector Fields

sections.title: Prerequisites & Intuitive Setup
lecture_lines: Vector fields assign vectors to points in space.
Imagine floating particles in a fluid flow.
Velocity of water defines the vector field.
animations: Fade in a static vector field grid in #FFFFFF.
Highlight a point and its local divergence using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/particle.svg].
Show fluid flowing outward from a positive source using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fluid.svg].
Show fluid flowing inward toward a negative sink using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fluid.svg].
Emphasize the source/sink relationship with labels in #FFFF00.

sections.title: Divergence: The 'Source/Sink' Concept
lecture_lines: Divergence measures field spreading or convergence.
Positive divergence indicates a source point.
Negative divergence signifies a sink point.
animations: Display a vector field representing a fluid flow.
Highlight the divergence operator at a point using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/faucet.svg] to represent the source.
Visualize expanding flow as positive divergence with #00FF00 labels, using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drain.svg] to represent the sink for negative divergence.

sections.title: Curl: The 'Rotation' Concept
lecture_lines: Curl measures a field's tendency to rotate.
Cross product models the axis of rotation.
Paddlewheel toys visualize local rotational curl.
animations: Display a static vector field representing rotation.
Highlight the curl operator circulating around a point.
Visualize rotational flow as non-zero curl with #00FFFF labels.

sections.title: Graphical Synthesis & Comparison
lecture_lines: Compare radial expansion and circular rotation.
Field A shows divergence without curl.
Field B shows curl without divergence.
animations: Show side-by-side comparison of divergence and curl fields using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Highlight differences in flow behavior using #FF00FF.
Summarize using a comparison table of operator properties incorporating the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/turbine.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Physical Significance
lecture_lines: Operators drive fluid and electromagnetic models.
animations: Summarize key takeaways for divergence and curl using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fluid.svg] to represent field flow.
Display the physical significance of both operators through the rotation of a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/turbine.svg].
Finalize with clear definitions and #FFFFFF text overlay highlighting the field properties.
